resources.string: This agreement is made between the landlord and the tenant for the flat at 14 Maple Street. The lease runs for twelve months from 1 March 2026.
The monthly rent is 850 euros, payable within the first five days of each month. A deposit equal to one month of rent is held until the end of the lease.
The appliances listed in the inventory are covered by the manufacturer’s warranty. The tenant will report any fault within seven days.
Billing period from 1 to 28 February 2026. Consumption of 214 kWh. The amount of 48.30 euros will be charged to your account on 10 March.
Billing period from 1 to 31 March 2026. Consumption of 386 kWh. The amount of 37.15 euros will be charged to your account on 12 April.
Fibre 600 Mb and landline for February 2026. The amount of 39.90 euros will be charged to your account on 5 March.
Water supply and sewerage from January to March 2026. Consumption of 21 cubic metres. Amount due: 52.80 euros.
Annual council tax for the flat at 14 Maple Street. It can be paid in two instalments, in May and in October.
Front-loading washing machine, 8 kg, delivered and installed on 3 February 2026. This appliance has a three-year warranty that covers parts and labour.
14-inch laptop with 16 GB of memory, bought on 18 January 2026. The two-year warranty runs from the date of this invoice. Keep it as proof of purchase.
Screen replaced on 9 March 2026. The repair has a six-month warranty. Damage caused by drops or liquids is not covered.
A vector space is a set that is closed under addition and under multiplication by a scalar. Its elements are called vectors.
Theorem. Every basis of a vector space of finite dimension has the same number of elements. That number is the dimension of the space.
Exercise. Show that the vectors (1, 0, 1), (0, 1, 1) and (1, 1, 0) are linearly independent, and write (2, 3, 1) as a combination of them.
